The member-wise copy is already optimal because the vector copy constructors perform a single contiguous copy; any manual reconstruction would add overhead. I kept the implementation identical to preserve exact behavior.

```cpp
Mesg::Mesg(const Mesg &mesg)
    : profile(mesg.profile)
    , localNum(mesg.localNum)
    , fields(mesg.fields)
    , devFields(mesg.devFields)
{
}
```
